claim_level: Exact bosonic SU5 adjoint and projector toy-model mechanism; not derived from E6 dynamics, does not prove Standard Model masses/couplings or any TOE.

exact_critical_point_classification.proof: Lagrange stationarity gives cubic in each xi with vanishing quadratic coefficient. Thus at most three roots. If three distinct, their sum is zero; trace and multiplicity constraints force a zero root and opposite remaining roots, with patterns (3,1,1) or (2,2,1). Two-root partitions give Q=((5-k)^3+k^3)/(25*k*(5-k)). Compactness proves the bound.

gauge_vs_global_orbit.SU5_gauge_orbit_statement: All 10 placements of fixed-sign (2,2,2,-3,-3) are conjugate by SU5, hence gauge-equivalent if SU5 is gauged; 10 physical domain types do not follow from a gauge-Weyl orbit.
gauge_vs_global_orbit.Z2_warning: Because V is Phi->-Phi even, opposite-sign eigenvalue multisets are NOT conjugate by SU5. Imposing this exact global Z2 introduces two gauge-inequivalent vacuum orbits; TrPhi³ term explicitly biases sign and can lift the degeneracy.
gauge_vs_global_orbit.global_discrete_case: If labels instead transform under a genuinely global A5, 10 placements of each sign are physically distinct degenerate minima. A macroscopic system may spontaneously choose one and form interfaces/domain walls; this does not prove such a global A5 exists.

landau_vacuum.nonsupersymmetric_caveat: A legitimate renormalizable bosonic SU5 adjoint potential; not derived as the scalar potential of the repo's F/D-flat supersymmetric E6 superpotential.
landau_vacuum.potential: V=-m²Tr(Phi²)+lambda(TrPhi²)²+kappa TrPhi⁴; Phi traceless Hermitian; no cubic

numerical_multistart_stress.optimizer: SciPy BFGS with 4 free diagonal coordinates and an exactly imposed traceless fifth coordinate

second_projector_alignment.Ky_Fan_ground_state: Unique rank-two projector onto the doubly degenerate smallest eigenvalue (-3v/sqrt30) subspace of Phi
second_projector_alignment.continuous_misalignment_cost: Delta V = (5 epsilon v/sqrt30) sin(theta)^2 when one weak eigenvector rotates into a colour eigenvector
second_projector_alignment.dynamical_field: Q=S S†, S complex 5x2 with S†S=I2; Q²=Q=Q† and TrQ=2
second_projector_alignment.gauge_invariant_portal: V_align = +epsilon Tr(Phi Q); Phi and Q transform by common SU5 conjugation
second_projector_alignment.open_E6_tasks: Find a gauge-invariant E6 or supersymmetric completion giving a positive kappa adjoint shape potential and a dynamical rank2 field, with all F/D equations, proton and triplet masses, and radiative/thermal consistency.
second_projector_alignment.physical_interpretation: Relative orientation of TWO dynamical Higgs/order-parameter fields is gauge invariant. This mechanism aligns them; it does not turn SU5 gauge-related placements of both fields into physically distinct vacua.
